row.notes: In Game_TyreAllocationComponent_SetPresetChoice: movzx eax,byte [r9+0x278] (8 bytes, no branch lands in the next 0x20 bytes). r9 = the weekend (Career Weekend, vt_Career_Weekend; from [component+0x270] vt+0x98 at 0x140bcbab0, also stored at [rsp+0x40]), eax = its track stat id (Weekend+0x278); r14 = the TyreAllocationComponent. The next instructions load r15 = [r14+0x278] (CareerEntity), [r15+0xf58] (TrackDataSystem) and its item vector +0x28..+0x30 (16 bytes per stat id, TrackDataRecord at +8), then call Ne_FatalAbort 0x1439182a0 at 0x140bcbdb0 when the stat id is >= the item count (jbe 0x140bcbb47) or the item's record is null (je 0x140bcbb59), and when Game_TrackData_GetTrack returns null (je 0x140bcbb88). EA 0x140bca48f (pattern unique in .rdata at 0xbca48a); EA minidumps of 2026-11-12 (crash-20261112-164529, crash-20261112-172549) show r9 a vt_Career_Weekend with +0x278 = 47, items 43 (rax 0x2f, rdx 0x2b at the abort) and 84 with item 47 null (rax 0x2f0, r12 0).
